title: Once Upon A Tide II Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Once Upon A Tide II is a 2 BR / 1 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Once Upon A Tide II is cozy enough for 4 as it contains both a King bedroom and a loft bedroom. It can be thought of as a private apartment lock-off to the main house (Once Upon A Tide).
description_expanded: Description142 SEASIDE AVENUE1 KING, 2 TWINS* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details.Spacious Lock-Off on Iconic Seaside AvenueOnce Upon A Tide II is a spacious lock-off cottage ideally located on one of Seaside’s most coveted streets, Seaside Avenue. Situated on an oversized lot, this charming retreat offers a central location just one block from the Seaside Town Center and Amphitheater, with the beach only a short stroll away. Designed to comfortably sleep up to four guests, the home features a king loft bedroom and a second bedroom with two twin beds, making it perfect for families or couples traveling together.Open-Air Porch & Inviting EntryGuests enter through a private side entrance that opens onto a large open-air porch furnished with outdoor dining for six. This shaded space is ideal for morning coffee, casual meals, or unwinding in the evening with a nightcap while enjoying the peaceful surroundings.Open Living, Dining & Kitchen AreaInside, soaring ceilings and an open-concept layout create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The living area flows seamlessly into the dining and kitchen spaces, making it easy to gather and relax. The dining table comfortably seats six, while the kitchen breakfast bar provides additional seating for four. The full-size kitchen is well equipped with stainless steel appliances and ample storage, offering everything needed for short or extended stays in Seaside.Upstairs Bedrooms & Private BalconiesUpstairs, the king loft bedroom serves as a serene retreat and features its own private furnished balcony—perfect for stepping outside to enjoy fresh air each morning. The second upstairs bedroom includes two twin beds and its own charming open-air balcony overlooking the landscaped yard, mature trees, and classic white picket fences. Both bedrooms share a full bathroom with a tub and shower combination.Flexible Lock-Off OptionFor guests seeking a more intimate stay, the one-bedroom lock-off configuration, Once Upon A Tide I, may be rented separately and comfortably sleeps two, offering flexibility without sacrificing location or comfort.* Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance. HVAC thermostat is locked to not allow air conditioning temperature to be set below 68.* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break; 5-night minimum Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURESFeatures 709 square feet4-minute walk to beach access approximately 352 yards to Savannah Pavilion; largest private residential beaches on 30ALocated on Seaside AvenueOutdoor showerCharcoal Grill Washer and dryerNetflix accessPeacock Alley Linens featuring fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts court fees apply, and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking information two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002215
